question: 人为制动预测误差/规划等待的现实性及当前阶段优先级
workflow: targeted multi-source literature and official documentation recheck, not systematic review

search.query: mobile manipulation robust nonprehensile object transportation model predictive control
search.note: The tool returned three CrossRef records and no arXiv-labelled discovery record, with errors=null. Known arXiv primary texts were opened separately. Returned broad results were screened by task relevance, not used as evidence of a research gap.

records.title: Toward multi-object nonprehensile transportation via shared teleoperation: A framework based on virtual object model predictive control
Keep It Upright: Model Predictive Control for Nonprehensile Object Transportation With Obstacle Avoidance on a Mobile Manipulator
records.used_for_decision: Already in stage-13 bibliography; no new method claim derived here.

records.title: Model-based control for nonprehensile manipulation of a two-rigid-link object by two cooperative arms

sources.title: Robust Nonprehensile Object Transportation with Uncertain Inertial Parameters
anchors: VI Robust Planning, offline plan with online tracking
sources.supports: Another real mobile manipulator has base tracking error; one-shot planning with feedback can be a meaningful strong baseline.
sources.does_not_support: No target-platform brake duration error distribution, no conversion from trajectory RMSE to 10%/20% emergency stop duration.

sources.title: Emergency Stopping for Liquid-manipulating Robots, preprint v1
sources.supports: Current-state feedback is part of the control implementation; core physical-parameter analysis and model misspecification are separate experiment questions.
sources.does_not_support: Pendulum-length misspecification percentages do not calibrate base braking errors; final journal full text not compared.

sources.title: RB-Y1 RobotState official documentation
anchors: RobotState field table: joint_states, velocity, odometry
sources.supports: The interface exposes state feedback and mobility odometry.
sources.does_not_support: No measured accuracy, emergency braking delay or stop-time uncertainty bound is provided by this field listing.

retrieval_limitations: An official Omron stopping-distance manual was found via search with stated test conditions; full PDF fetch failed because of content length. It is not used to assign target-platform error magnitudes.
Pinned model-only source location did not contain README/examples; no claim about its runtime control behavior was derived from missing files.
recommended_sequence: Complete basic state feedback and check computation availability.
Demonstrate the nominal short-stop/finite-stroke task with credible strong baselines and continuous object metrics.
After the method and task are defined, test bounded uncertainties with documented or measured provenance.
